content:
The ideal growing conditions for Southern Cordyline seeds are:

- Temperature: 20°C - 25°C
- Hydrometry rate: 50% - 70%
- Sunshine rate: 6 hrs - 8 hrs
- Rainfall: 800 mm - 1200 mm
- Humidity rate: 60% - 80%
- Soil type: Well-drained soil
